profile.reading: This is Lepidas fourth regional data center, known as the Modena Innovation Hub, occupying the first floor and part of a two above ground floor building of about 1,600 square meters, or roughly 17,200 square feet, in the MASA, or Modena Automotive Smart Area, district within Modenas Progetto Periferie neighborhood, Italy. The facility opened in spring 2021, funded with more than 5 million euros from the Italian governments Bando Periferie urban regeneration program, and was purpose built for data center use rather than adapted from an earlier building, unlike some of Lepidas other regional sites. The Emilia-Romagna regional government formally recognized it as Lepidas fourth regional data center through resolution DGR 1055 of 2020. Beyond hosting data center and cloud services, the building also houses a Cyber Security Academy and supports the MASA automotive research program run with the University of Modena and Reggio Emilia, with the City of Modena granting Lepida usage rights and maintenance responsibility while the site consolidates and replaces previously separate data centers run by local public entities. Lepida S.c.p.A. is registered at Via della Liberazione 15 in Bologna with about 69.9 million euros in registered capital, majority owned by the Emilia-Romagna Region, and operates as the regions in house information and communications technology consortium company, serving more than 450 public entities across regional and metropolitan network infrastructure, cloud computing, healthcare and public administration software platforms including LepidaID and electronic health records, digital welfare integration, and emergency services, holding ISO 9001, 27001, 37001, 45001, and 14001 certifications. In September 2025, international network operator RETN opened a point of presence inside a Lepida data center in Bologna, confirming that at least some Lepida sites also function as active interconnection points for third party network operators rather than serving only regional government workloads.
